# Qraft

> Free, client-side QR code generator. Paste a link or text, pick a pattern (square, dots, rounded, classy, elegant), ink color and size, then download a PNG. No sign-up; nothing is uploaded.

- [Qraft QR code generator](https://qraft.ashutoshswamy.in): the generator and FAQ

Built by Ashutosh Swamy (https://ashutoshswamy.in).
